test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the Economic Survey of India 2020-2021, which state is NOT showing gain in its forest cover?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The India state of forest report 2021 has vindicated what activists, lawyers and academicians have been saying all along**- Arunachal Pradesh, Which is second-largest forested state in India, is losing its primary forests and that too at a large scale every passing year.**
 
• As per the ISFR 2021- brought out by the Forest Survey of India (FSI) and released on January 13-** Arunachal Pradesh has a geographical area (GA of 83,743 sq km with its 16 hill districts, has witnessed a loss of 257 sq km of forest cover compared to the 2019 asssessment.**
 
• **Increasing in Arunachal Pradesh is the dumping of muck and road-building debris on the slopes by the contractors.**
 
• Not just in the area where Krong lives but in other district .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
